description:
New employee Oh Nayeon hates her supervisor, Kang Jaehee. Although Jaehee is famous in the company for being talented, polite, and multilingual, Nayeon sees her as nothing more than an unpleasant person. One day, Nayeon unexpectedly ends up framing Jaehee, and Jaehee begins to harass her in weird ways...
